food_selection_strategy: Favor calorie-dense, nutrient-dense whole foods and adequate protein at every meal so total intake is easier to hit; complex carbs and healthy fats are welcome.
Favor a balanced spread of protein, carbs and fats each meal; slightly favor protein-rich and muscle-supportive foods without skewing the plan toward any one macro.
Favor high-protein, high-fiber, nutrient-dense foods with controlled calorie density; favor foods that are filling relative to their calories.
